source: Clean scalar cyclic-DCP phase samples with IID uniform classical labels modulo 2^t; no coherent label oracle, preparation inverse or accessible environment
native_family: n=t-8 components, uniform fixed native secret in Z_(2^t)^n and IID uniform original full labels; either clean accepted explicitly or independent injected Z visibility 1-1/n
required_unimplemented_primitive: For every supported dimension, predict first native secret parity with average advantage at least inverse polynomial using polynomial original copies and finite-gate time
reduction: Choose one private global uniform mask per fresh predictor invocation; augment scalar labels, apply known private phase rotations, unmask one parity prediction, amplify and remove the recovered scalar prefix on fresh original samples
private_control_data_not_decoder_inputs: global mask including known auxiliary native secret coordinates
known phase correction angles and recovered scalar prefix
independent injected fault coins and preparation workspace
proof_obligations: Exact source pushforward for every fixed scalar secret, with one mask shared across all samples in an invocation
Uniform fresh label truncation after correct prefix removal, without postselection
Uniform inverse-polynomial predictor advantage at EVERY stage with fresh masks, samples, randomness and workspace
Charge original source copies, auxiliary randomness, bounded rejection coins, private phase arithmetic, and finite-gate precision
Explicitly charge terminal enumeration 2^(n0+7) when predictor supports only n>=n0; polynomial conclusion requires fixed n0
Verify suffix candidates on fresh CLEAN original samples and charge approximate-control error separately

copy_bounds.specified_bit: First-coordinate parity corresponds to target frequency h=(q/2,0,...,0)
copy_bounds.exact_blindness: Absent a Boolean frequency difference h, parity-conditioned source densities coincide; all secret-blind subsequent instruments remain blind
copy_bounds.clean_average_advantage_upper: min(1/2,(2^K-1)/(2*q^n)) for K TOTAL original IID phase qubits, including all rejected or adaptively selected draws
copy_bounds.independent_noise_average_advantage_uppe: min(1/2,((1+v)^K-1)/(2*q^n)); independent original Z faults required, not merely equal marginal visibilities
copy_bounds.scope: These are necessary copy thresholds, not sufficient resources or computational lower bounds; clean upper bound survives any secret-blind noise channel

falsifiers: An actual original-source density violates the target-frequency identity or the clean subset-sum overlap formula
A claimed native predictor budget violates its necessary average-advantage bound
A predictor reads private masks, known auxiliary secrets, preparation angles or fault tags
A recursion reuses measured samples, refreshes masks per packet, or fails to cost its unsupported-dimension tail
A proposed implementation assumes free growing-modulus rotations or replaces total-information lower bounds by a useful-bit guarantee
